name: Money for Girls: Amortized
source:
A girl detective faces her greatest mystery yet: saving her mom from crippling debt. But beware: the gorgeous tropical landscape conceals a world of sin. The popular girl at school has shown a disturbing interest in you, and your mother's predatory loan is dressed to kill. Can your sugary heart survive, or will the ants feast?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4833450/]Steam[/url]]
